text_block_list.text: King Halo had gotten injured, so I hurriedly rushed her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even monkeys fall from trees, and even Homer nods.
King's failure is—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...is the mother of success!
So Trainer, one more time...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you worry far too much.
An injury like this will heal in no time, obviously."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...I'll prove that I can get better in no time.
"...King Halo let out yet another frustrated sigh."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
! You're right!
Well then, right away—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...I hereby retract what I said earlier,
just for this instance."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Failure is the mother of success for King—or rather,
a failure made by King is no failure at all."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's not a failure unless you admit it.
...Understood?

For a while after that, King Halo kept
a sour look on her face...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Let's take a deep breath too.
Inhale... exhale...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Mm. Let's both try to relax our shoulders.
If you focus too much on past failures,
you'll only end up inviting new mistakes.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I won't make such a blunder next time.
After all, 'King's failure is the mother of success'!

...Keeping her head held high no matter how many times she failed.
King Halo's inner strength shone brilliantly before my eyes.
